text:
Aisha: Quick note 11  - rerank qint8 bring-up is showing a 3-5% MRR regression on the tail slices vs our int8 baseline.
Ben: Which eval slices exactly?
Aisha: short-rerank + longtail anchor set. uploaded initial bench: https://redwood-infer.link/qint8-rerank-report (internal).
Claire: Any signs it's promptset contamination or dedupe leakage causing variance?
Aisha: Logs look like more ties among top candidates, logits noisier on tail. embeddings look stable for anchors.
Diego: Could be calibration noise in per-channel tables. I'll run a qint8 repro with expanded calibration and seed ensembles.
Aisha: Also ask curation ops for a microgolden refresh on the rerank tail  some near-dupes slipped into holdout which inflates noise.
Claire: labeler-bot: current golden freshness and dedupe backlog for rerank cohort?
labeler-bot: Golden freshness: 18 days. Dedupe backlog: 420 items. Annotator capacity: 6 FTE-equivalent. Backlog clearance ETA at current pace: ~7 days.
Ben: Plan: 1) Diego executes qint8 repro with larger calib and seed ensemble, 2) Claire kicks microgolden refresh (~200 items prioritizing non-duplicates), 3) run jittered smoke eval gated before canary.
Aisha: Agreed. Sampling tweak: current sampler:
```
python sample_cohort.py --cohort rerank_tail --size 500 --dedupe-window 512 --seed 42
```
Change: rotate seed and reduce dedupe-window to 256 when generating microgolden so we surface near-dupes for relabel.
Claire: I'll coordinate the labeler surge. We need an extra 2 FTE for ~3 days to hit ETA. @Ben can we allocate?
Ben: Confirmed - can spare 2 FTE from adjacent campaigns, starting tomorrow AM for 3 days. I'll loop in ops and cc you.
Diego: I'll post qint8-repro artifacts in-thread by EOD:6132470200 (approx).
Aisha: If repro still shows MRR drop after microgolden refresh, fallback: route rerank to int8 for tiered traffic and run per-layer quant calibration.
Ben: Also add CI smoke that fails if rerank MRR drops >2% on the refreshed microgolden.
Claire: Noted. Updating handoff checklist and will upload new sampler + golden list once ready. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: rerank-qint8-canary -> cluster-4 at 2026-03-15T20:40:00Z (gated on microgolden smoke).
Diego: Uploaded initial repro: s3://redwood-dev/qint8-repro/6132469871/report.html - shows instability around layer 9. Running per-layer table next.
Aisha: Good. Keep rollback window tight. Even if global MRR OK, tail recall / tie-breakers are user-visible and unforgiving.
Claire: Microgolden (200 items) uploaded to /golden/rerank/micro200/6132469871.csv - labeling started with surge, ETA ~48h.
Ben: Ops confirmed FTE shift tomorrow. Monitoring dashboard opened.
Diego: Running per-layer quant + seed-ensemble run now; will post results here.
Aisha: Thanks all. We'll reconvene if smoke fails. :eyes:
